scope: Two authenticated human seats, each controls five champions; text and local voice produce untrusted natural language, never trusted packets.

preflight.auth: server validates session token; resolves seatID/team/unitIds from private room state; 5 units/seat; rejects if already ready
preflight.compile: server-side PTBR compiler or verified authoritative server mapper; use only public/own-team permitted data for any client-visible summary
preflight.privacy: never return full enemy Arena or map knowledge, hidden target IDs, raw private snapshots or RNG

commit.auth: same authenticated session and seat as the server-held draft
barriers: revision equals preview revision or explicit compatible conflict policy
world not paused at pendingDecision unless authorized reaction
all commands validated and own five units only
commit.atomicity: all-or-nothing apply compiled multiple actions, or refuse entire plan; never silently drop unsupported action
commit.idempotence: persist typed receipt and canonical intent by (match,seat,round,request_id) before ACK; exact replay returns same receipt after seal/reconnect; conflict rejected

server_side_draft.store: opaque draft ID, unforgeable, bound to seat+epoch+round+revision, finite TTL; never accept client-authored command array
server_side_draft.reference_limitation: QA reference currently uses sequential IDs and in-memory Map; NOT suitable for production

redactions: raw transcript unless explicitly permitted to save

voice.consent: manual opt-in; processLocally true; no fallback to remote speech recognition
voice.text: only final transcript enters preview; never auto-commit
voice.feature_gap: legacy app.js local voice/commands; legacy multiplayer/pvp_client_v453_dev47.js does not wire voice or text

qa.a11_reference: 20/20 PASS executed V8 with actual legacy Arena+Room+Gateway
qa.coverage: 44 parser probes (22 Portuguese phrases x blue/red) executed V8 source
qa.legacy_security_gap: room.ready set while arena.teams[team].ready remains false; direct offline applyCommands can mutate, but no HTTP text endpoint exists

requirements.expected: derive seat/team from cookie; no client-supplied seat authority
once a seat confirms, absolutely no new text or voice commits to that seat until next round
reject entire intent if one action unsupported or disallowed; no prefix side effects
reject stale preview by match+round+revision/epoch; require fresh preview after external state change
previews and receipts only contain own-team/public-visible information
canonical immutable command and idempotent requestId recoverable after lost ACK and server restore
one human may command all five owned units; cannot impersonate opponent
opt-in local-only pt-BR, no silent remote fallback or auto-apply
preserve plans/policies through ready, turn, and checkpoint; no accidental follow-lane overwrite
server-only snapshots, typed VisibleEventDTO default-deny, privacy in SSE/resync
